# Bounce — account brief

## Who

Bounce runs a network of luggage storage locations in cities around the world, described on its homepage as "Bounce | Luggage Storage Near You — Store your bags with Bounce" ([source](https://usebounce.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the company as Bounce at usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in usebounce/bounce-app ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/eas.json))
- package.json pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json))
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- The org has 14 public repos and 96 followers ([source](https://github.com/usebounce))
- usebounce/bounce-app last pushed 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app))
- The App Store listing has 12,800 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349))
- 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349))

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@usebounce-maintainer-1), top contributor to usebounce/bounce-app with 118 commits ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)); profile lists company "Bounce" and website https://usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@usebounce-maintainer-2), 64 commits to usebounce/bounce-app ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-2)); profile lists company "Bounce" and website https://usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-2))
- Maintainer Three (@usebounce-maintainer-3), 22 commits to usebounce/bounce-app ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-3)); profile lists company "Bounce" and website https://usebounce.com ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-3))

## Why now

The app shipped 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)), and the repo was last pushed on 2026-08-18 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app)). It runs react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One, you have 118 commits in usebounce/bounce-app, the most of anyone on the repo ([source](https://github.com/usebounce-maintainer-1)). That repo has an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside CI workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the app shipped 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)). At that cadence, where does the handoff between your GitHub workflows and your EAS builds cost you the most time?
